items.title: Trump Administration Divide on China Policy Breaks Into Public View

items.title: Madison Huang, Jensen Huang’s Daughter, Became a Powerful Force at Nvidia

items.summary: The announcement appeared to be a response to recent criticism that the Commerce Department has moved too slowly on the alleged chip smuggling case.

items.title: Debt Problems of the Richest Countries Are Trickling Down to the Poorest

items.title: Nearly two million people are behind bars in the US. How did we get here?
items.summary: Lynn Novick's new, four-part PBS documentary series, Crime and Punishment in America, goes inside the U.S. prison system and explores how our approach to criminals has changed over time.
